origin.description: MATCH is the generic form of match. The result is the one-based position of the first match. NA matches NA and does not match NaN.

arguments.name: table
arguments.text: Values to match against. The first match wins.

arguments.name: nomatch
arguments.text: Returned when there is no match. It is coerced to integer. The default is NA.
